title: Tailscale Subnet Router Offline Gap
app: OpenWrt, UniFi, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, DNS over HTTPS resolvers, and scheduled probes via syslog, APIs, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tailscale:netmap role=subnet_router
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by node
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Uses Tailscale subnet-router status telemetry to monitor how long advertised subnet routers have been missing in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for private-network reachability gaps before they surprise you, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tailscale subnet-router status data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Node table of hours since last subnet-router update.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how long advertised subnet routers have been missing so you can spot private-network reachability gaps before they surprise you before it becomes annoying.
